title: native_sim test-infra breakage cluster at pinned v3.7.0 tree (coap_status switch-enum, COAP_CLIENT prio assert, rx_stack collision, qemu_x86 entropy link)
description: Found during project-LICHEN-worker6-sb0b validation; several block ANY CONFIG_LICHEN=y Zephyr build. (1) FIXED in sb0b: coap_status.c trust_level_str lacked a case for LICHEN_COAP_TRUST_UNKNOWN -> -Werror=switch-enum (default: does not suppress -Wswitch-enum); case added, behavior identical to old default. (2) OPEN: Zephyr COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY defaults to NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES (=idle priority) -> z_init_static_threads assert 'invalid priority (15)' before any test runs; LICHEN selects COAP_CLIENT via LICHEN_L2_IF->LICHEN_COAP. Workaround exists (set =14, done in ping_l2 + coap_client tests) but gateway/puck prj.confs do NOT set it - audit all apps/boards (pre-existing boot-assert risk on real boards). (3) OPEN: base lora_l2.c defined a global rx_stack that collides with Zephyr net_tc.c rx_stack (multiple definition at link) - latent, only bites configs building net TC + old L2; gone after sb0b but symbols were renamed only in the new code. (4) OPEN: qemu_x86 cannot link L2 at all - sys_csrand_get undefined (no entropy driver on qemu_x86; all existing qemu_x86 test configs set CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_L2=n for this reason), so the sb0b acceptance clause 'qemu_x86 build of an app pulling L2' is only satisfiable to object-compile level; needs either an entropy shim/test driver for qemu_x86 or an explicit Kconfig gate. Verify (2) and (4) after fixing.
